faq.q: Do You Provide Wine Or Champagne?
faq.a: Can I Bring My Own? All of our cruises come with a complimentary bottle of sparkling cider, sparklng water, or plain flat water. We do offer the purchase of a bottle of wine (merlot or chardonnay) or champagne as an upgrade to the beverage provided. Guests must be over 21 to purchase this option. Because we offer wine and champagne as an amenity on the gondola, you will find our prices to be pleasantly competitive. Click here for current brands and prices. quotes.author: Tiffany V., Yelp
quotes.text: I will not refer business to anyone that I don't believe will be treated and have a wonderful memory because of someone I trust and know. Being in the wedding industry, I have to only refer what I feel is the best. The romance and ambiance in Newport Harbor, the gondolier... GO YOU WILL have a wonderful memory for the rest of your life!

quotes.author: Jeffrey T., Yelp
quotes.text: I called them with a proposal idea on a gondola. They treated me like I'm the only customer they've ever had. Everyone I had contact with was extremely polite and accommodating. I am beyond impressed with their level of customer service. My fiancé had a proposal fit for a princess. Your company is truly one in a million!

quotes.author: a1tourstravel, TripAdvisor
quotes.text: From initially booking this reservation with Anne to the cruise itself, everything went extremely well. We had a group of 42 people and 7 amazing gondoliers. They all made our evening so very special from beginning to end. The evening was perfect....the gondoliers were perfect....and even the weather was perfect!

quotes.author: 997cbrown, TripAdvisor
quotes.text: We took a dinner cruise with Eddie. It was really one of the best meals we had on our week stay in Newport Beach. I surprised my husband with a message in a bottle. My husband said it was the sweetest thing I had ever done for him. Cannot say enough good things about our cruise. It was the highlight of our trip.

quotes.author: Slowmotion4, TripAdvisor
quotes.text: Thank you Newport Gondola and Anne for an awesome gondola cruise experience!!! We took our couples fellowship (36 people) and the Company was very accommodating and Anne even helped make arrangements for dinner. The gondoliers shared Italian history and traditions and sang for us. We had a great time!!!

quotes.author: Rebecca A, TripAdvisor
quotes.text: This was one of those moments that will forever be in my heart. My Fiance proposed to me on this magical ride. The team goes above and beyond and exceeded my fiance's expectations by leaps and bounds. These moments are priceless, and without the team, they would not be what they are.
